subject: Renewal check-in: usage profile & conversion path (term/commit options)
messages:
From: Sara Nguyen <sara@brightlabs.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal planning — need a usage snapshot and proposal framing

Hi Olga / Ben,

We kick off our renewal conversation next month and procurement asked for a short usage & performance summary to help justify a term change on our side. Can you provide: 
- A 90-day token breakdown (prompt vs completion, embeddings)
- p50/p95 latency figures and any recent infra changes that impacted cost or latency
- A simple cost/benefit framing if we move from month-to-month to a 12‑month commit (showing committed unit rate vs on‑demand)

We're also evaluating a modest uptick in capacity to support a new feature (approx +30% tokens/month). The commercial lead (procurement@brightlabs.com) is on the thread.

Could you get a one-pager and a short quote by EOD tomorrow?

Thanks —
Sara
Sara Nguyen
Director, Platform Engineering — BrightLabs

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara@brightlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Aug 2028 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — need a usage snapshot and proposal framing

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear ask. Attached is a concise snapshot I put together: brightlabs_perf_aug2028.pdf (summary) and usage_snapshot_aug2028.csv (raw tokens). High-level takeaways below — we'll follow up with a quote.

Summary highlights (90d window ending 2028-07-31):
- Total tokens: 1.2B tokens (prompt 480M, completion 640M).
- Embeddings: 12M vectors (approx. 48M tokens equivalent) — mostly nightly batch jobs.
- Latency: p50 ~ 90ms, p95 ~ 260ms (for your standard 512-token request mix). No recent infra changes deployed that affect latency; improvements earlier this quarter reduced p95 by ~30ms for long-context requests.
- Cost mix: ~72% of spend is generation (completion tokens), 28% is prompts/embeddings.

Conversion/commit framing: moving to a 12-month commit at a 20% committed discount yields ~18% net unit-cost reduction vs current on-demand effective rates once you account for expected token mix. If you also shift embeddings to a reserved pricing tier we can achieve another ~6% improvement on that slice.

Operational note: your spike risk is concentrated in two nightly batch windows — we recommend adding a modest burst buffer (30% burst credits) to avoid throttling and to keep latency SLOs intact if volume grows.

I've included a simple ROI table in the attached PDF. Ben / Monica: starting a draft quote for +30% capacity (monthly commit) would be great — include both the 12‑month commit and an alternate 6‑month staged uplift option.

Next steps: Ben to share draft pricing; Olga to join renewal call next Tuesday.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- brightlabs_perf_aug2028.pdf (performance summary, charts)
- usage_snapshot_aug2028.csv (token-level export)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara@brightlabs.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Aug 2028 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — need a usage snapshot and proposal framing

Sara / team — attaching an initial commercial sketch: proposal_dedicated_quote_v1.pdf (stub). Key points in the sketch:

1) Baseline 12‑month commit (matches current usage + 30% uplift)
   - Committed tokens/month: 130M (vs current ~100M run‑rate)
   - Committed unit price: $0.00016 / token (20% off on‑demand blended)
   - Embeddings reserved tier: 30% discount on vector pricing if committed

2) 6‑month staged uplift (conservative)
   - 6 months at current commit, then re-evaluate uplift to full 130M
   - Slightly higher unit price (5% delta) but allows runway for your feature launch

3) Burst credits & SLA consideration
   - Add 30% burst credits as a fail-safe for nightly batches (no additional baseline commitment; pay-as-used overage with capped rate)
   - Option to add Dedicated pool for critical paths (separate pricing) if you want guaranteed p95 < 200ms at peak — we included a placeholder number for that in page 4.

4) Commercial asks from BrightLabs we can accommodate quickly:
   - Longer invoicing window (45 days) — OK for standard enterprise plan
   - One-time migration credit ($5k) if you upgrade to embeddings reserved tier within contract start window

Sara — can you confirm whether procurement prefers a single 12‑month invoice or quarterly invoicing? That will change the cash terms and slightly change our standard discounting treatment.

I'll be on the renewal call next Tuesday and can walk through the numbers.

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposal_dedicated_quote_v1.pdf (commercial sketch, not final)

Thanks Ben / Olga — this is exactly the level of detail we need. A couple quick clarifying Qs from procurement: 
1) If we take the 12‑month commit with the embeddings reserved tier, what is the exact blended unit price for our current mix (using the 90d split Olga sent)? Please show an example monthly invoice for our current run rate and for the +30% uplift month.
2) For the burst credits, what is the overage billing cadence and cap? Procurement wants predictable worst-case exposure.

Procurement prefers quarterly invoicing if possible; they will confirm formally but flagged that preference.

If you can update the sketch with the two numbers above before the call that would be great. We'll aim to have procurement on the call.

—Sara

Sara — quick follow up on the two procurement asks Ben flagged: 

1) Blended example invoice (attached in-line):
   - Current run-rate month (~100M tokens):
     • Prompt: 40M tokens @ $0.00010 = $4,000
     • Completion: 60M tokens @ $0.00020 = $12,000
     • Embeddings (on-demand): 4M vectors @ $0.003 / vector = $12,000
     • Total = $28,000 (baseline)
   - With 12‑month commit + embeddings reserved tier (example):
     • Prompt: 40M tokens @ $0.00008 = $3,200
     • Completion: 60M tokens @ $0.00016 = $9,600
     • Embeddings (reserved): 4M vectors @ $0.0021 / vector = $8,400
     • Total = $21,200 (24% reduction vs baseline)
2) Burst credits billing and cap:
   - Overage billed monthly at capped rate = committed unit price + 40% (cap)
   - We can set a hard monthly overage budget cap (e.g., $15k) and alerting thresholds.
Ben: I'm linking the updated pricing sketch to HubSpot and will add a 2-column invoice example for current vs +30% uplift.
Marissa: please prepare the DocuSign envelope once Sara confirms the preferred term and billing cadence.
